# 阶段三：HiAgent/Coze、三动作窗口、Midscene 与脚本生成系统 v5.1

> 版本：5.1.0  
> PoC 依据：PoC-02、PoC-03 通过；PoC-01 完成适配器和 Live 脚本，真实公司模型联调待环境。

## 1. 目标

将人工成功案例转换为可执行、可验证、可下载、可挂载定时任务的 Playwright Script Package。

## 2. Agent 输入

```text
自然语言
格式化案例
视频
案例文件
上述任意组合
```

Agent 必须确认：

```text
案例名称
入口 URL
角色/认证
测试数据
动作范围
成功终态
输出方式
是否挂载定时任务
```

## 3. 工程结构

```text
services/hiagent-coze-adapter/
services/task-relay/
services/local-authoring-bridge/
services/authoring-control-service/
workers/video-analysis-worker/
workers/midscene-replication-worker/
workers/trace-normalization-worker/
workers/script-context-worker/
packages/action-window/
packages/interaction-trace/
packages/locator-normalizer/
packages/model-adapter/
packages/script-security/
packages/output-adapter/
```

## 4. Source Normalization

```json
{
  "caseRef":"REG-PAY-001",
  "inputModes":["NATURAL_LANGUAGE","VIDEO"],
  "businessGoal":"完成本行转账并验证成功",
  "entryUrl":"http://127.0.0.1:18082/transfers/new",
  "baselineRef":"BASE-PAY-001",
  "uncertainties":[]
}
```

## 5. FullActionPlan

```json
{
  "planId":"PLAN-001",
  "caseId":"REG-PAY-001",
  "steps":[
    {"stepId":"S1","action":"SELECT","target":"收款人","valueRef":"fixture.customer.bob"},
    {"stepId":"S2","action":"FILL","target":"转账金额","valueRef":"fixture.amount"},
    {"stepId":"S3","action":"CLICK","target":"确认转账"}
  ],
  "expectedResultRef":"BASE-PAY-001"
}
```

Plan Harness：

```text
Schema
动作白名单
URL 白名单
FixtureRef
最大动作数
成功终态
安全策略
```

## 6. ActionWindowController

完整计划只在 State Store。视觉调用：

```json
{
  "windowId":"PLAN-001:S2",
  "previous":{"stepId":"S1","summary":"已选择客户乙","result":"PASSED"},
  "current":{"stepId":"S2","action":"FILL","target":"转账金额","valueRef":"fixture.amount"},
  "next":{"stepId":"S3","summary":"点击确认转账"},
  "actionBudget":1
}
```

状态：

source: background information/落地方案 V5.1/阶段三_HiAgent_Coze三动作窗口Midscene脚本生成系统_v5.1.md
text:
```text
PENDING → READY → EXECUTING → OBSERVED → PASSED/FAILED/AMBIGUOUS
```

错误时不推进游标。

## 7. Midscene 动作映射

```text
CLICK       → aiTap
FILL        → aiInput
CLEAR       → aiClearInput
KEY         → aiKeyboardPress
SCROLL      → aiScroll
HOVER       → aiHover
LOCATE      → aiLocate
WAIT        → aiWaitFor
```

`aiAct` 不是默认路径。

## 8. VisualModelAdapter

配置：

```text
MIDSCENE_MODEL_BASE_URL
MIDSCENE_MODEL_API_KEY
MIDSCENE_MODEL_NAME
MIDSCENE_MODEL_FAMILY
COMPANY_VISUAL_CONTEXT_LIMIT=16384
```

Adapter 负责：

```text
图像尺寸和压缩
Token 预算
模型请求
坐标格式标准化
超时和重试
敏感数据策略
指标
```

PoC-01 Live 门禁：

```text
20 控件定位
10 输入
10 下拉框
5 iframe
5 弹窗/新页面
5 DPI
```

## 9. Playwright Instrumentation

安装顺序：

```text
new Context
→ start tracing
→ install request/response/console/dialog/popup/download listeners
→ create page
→ navigate
```

每步采集：

```text
Before/After Screenshot
URL/Title
DOM/ARIA
文本/控件类型
输入前后值
Locator 候选和唯一性
Network
Console/Dialog/Popup/Download
等待条件
业务输出
```

## 10. Stable StepTrace

```json
{
  "stepId":"S3",
  "requested":{"action":"CLICK","target":"确认转账"},
  "element":{
    "tagName":"button",
    "role":"button",
    "accessibleName":"确认转账",
    "testId":"transfer-confirm"
  },
  "locatorCandidates":[
    {"type":"TEST_ID","value":"transfer-confirm","unique":true,"score":100}
  ],
  "waitCondition":{"type":"HTTP_RESPONSE","pathPattern":"/api/v1/transfers","status":201},
  "stateAfter":{"visibleTexts":["转账成功"],"businessState":"SETTLED"}
}
```

Midscene Dump 通过版本 Adapter 转换，不作为永久内部协议。

## 11. Trace Completeness Gate

强制字段：

```text
步骤状态
Before/After
目标元素
稳定 Locator
输入引用
等待条件
页面状态
关键网络
输出提取
成功终态
Evidence Hash
```

门槛：`>= 98%`。

## 12. ScriptGenerationContext

只发送：

source: background information/落地方案 V5.1/阶段三_HiAgent_Coze三动作窗口Midscene脚本生成系统_v5.1.md
text:
```text
Goal
Canonical Steps
Approved Locators
Inputs/Outputs
Wait Conditions
Assertions
Page Object 规划
Fixture 规则
Coding/Security 规则
```

禁止发送 Cookie、Token、Storage State、原始密码、完整 HAR 和无关 DOM。

## 13. 主控 LLM 输出

```text
manifest.json
pages/*.page.ts
fixtures/*.fixture.ts
tests/*.spec.ts
expected/baseline.json
```

代码规范：

```text
TypeScript strict
@playwright/test
Page Object
Fixture
test.step
语义 Locator
确定性 Wait
明确 Assertion
无坐标默认动作
无 Secret
```

## 14. 工具链

```text
tool.case.normalize
tool.plan.validate
tool.replication.create
tool.task.get
tool.trace.validate
tool.script.validate
tool.artifact.publish
tool.schedule.create
```

所有长任务使用 Relay：幂等、TTL、Lease、Heartbeat、Cancel、Result。

## 15. 输出

只有阶段二返回：

```text
SCRIPT_VALIDATED
BASELINE_MATCHED
```

Agent 才返回：

```text
artifactId
fileName
version
sha256
validationSummary
downloadUrl/fileId
scheduleOption
```

## 16. HiAgent/Coze Adapter

必须适配：

```text
文件上传
会话创建
流式输出
requires_action
submit tool outputs
Artifact 链接/附件
Schedule 管理
```

平台能力未开放时，通过内部 Adapter 补齐，不改变核心业务协议。

## 17. 指标

```text
replication_first_pass_rate
action_success_rate
trace_completeness_ratio
visual_calls_per_case
script_compile_rate
script_validation_first_pass_rate
baseline_match_rate
authoring_duration_seconds
```

## 18. Definition of Done

- 三种输入可用；
- 三动作窗口严格生效；
- Midscene Live PoC 通过公司模型验收；
- Playwright 轨迹完整度达标；
- 主控 LLM 可生成脚本包；
- 阶段二独立验证通过；
- Agent 可返回下载入口；
- 测试人员可确认定时挂载；
- 审计和指标完整。
